prompt:
A desktop web app screen, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window or device. Product: Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent does tasks on its own computer. The visitor's job: see what the agent is doing, answer it, and review finished work before it goes out. Workspace: Fern & Fig (a plant shop). Channels launch, design, ops, hiring; Chat, Tasks, Files, Goals, Computer. Badge '2 need you'. #launch chat: Priya 'Photos are in, hero is the maidenhair fern.'; Marcus '@hive what do we still need before the send?'; Hive's short reply listing what is left. Tasks: 'Write the launch email' (agent, ready for your review, 18m, due Fri, buttons Mark done and Send back); 'Set up the pre-order page' (agent, running, 42m); 'Order 8-inch boxes' (failed, supplier out of stock); 'Brief support on pre-order questions' (Dana, to do). Hive bee mark top left. PINNED PALETTE, use only these plus a muted red for failure: dark navy #031D44, medium blue #1C4768, bright blue #22B1E0, teal green #1CCC80, light cyan #91E4E7, light gray #EEF2F5. The references are style inspiration for a real working product; their layout, content and colours are not to be copied, the pinned palette overrides their colours.
Look: a Wim Crouwel construction grid. Light gray ground with the layout grid visible as faint bright-blue hairlines across the whole screen. The channel name 'launch' is set monumental in letterforms built cell by cell on that grid; everything else is small neutral grotesk in navy. One earned accent plane: the review task sits on a solid bright-blue block with navy text. Standard navigation and controls, left navigation, chat centre, tasks right. Bold, rigorous, unmistakable.
